summary: Verified NotificationBar on public site and full admin CRUD for Announcements, Events, Team, Reviews, and Blogs. Backend: created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_admin_crud.py (7 tests, 100% pass) that performs mandatory-TOTP admin login (setup flow with pyotp), then POST → public GET verification → PUT → DELETE for each resource + a 401 negative test. Frontend: Playwright verified that on the homepage the notification bar renders with data-testid='notification-bar', text '🎓 Admissions open for 2026 batch — limited seats!', link data-testid='notification-bar-link' href='/free-counselling', and the close button data-testid='notification-bar-close' dismisses the bar. Public /events, /team, /blogs pages return 200.

issues: Next/Image warnings for /images/logo-blue.png and preloaded font woff2 (cosmetic, unchanged from prior iteration)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4885 lines — long-standing recommendation to split into modules (admin auth, leads, content CRUD, seed data) still stands.

Admin login flow with xdist parallel workers causes a race: both workers hit requires_setup, each generates a different fresh secret, whichever confirms last wins and the other becomes invalid. Fixed in tests by running with -n0. Not a production bug, but worth noting: if two admins hit /admin/login simultaneously on first-ever setup they can race. Consider adding a serialising lock or checking totp_enabled again inside the confirm branch.

NotificationBar: dismiss state is component-local (useState), so it does NOT persist across reloads — bar reappears on refresh. If persistence per-visitor is desired, use localStorage keyed by announcement id.
NotificationBar API URL: uses process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || '' — relies on relative /api proxy. Consistent with rest of app, OK.
test_credentials: Admin password from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (ETIadmin@2026). TOTP secret is generated fresh on first login and captured by tests via pyotp.
seed_data_creation: Test CRUD created + deleted announcements, events, team members, reviews, blogs with names prefixed TEST_ / slugs 'test-blog-*'. All were deleted at end of each test — no residual test data left in MongoDB. After tests, admin 2FA was reset back to fresh-setup state via db.admin_users update.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise admin endpoints, use TestClient flow in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_crud.py: POST /api/admin/login {password} → response has {requires_setup, secret}; then POST again with {password, otp=pyotp.TOTP(secret).now(), pending_secret=secret} → returns {token}. IMPORTANT: run this file with `pytest -n0` (no xdist) because the two-step setup flow races when parallel workers each request a fresh secret. If 2FA already enabled (secret unrecoverable), reset with: db.admin_users.update_many({'role':'admin'}, {'$set':{'totp_secret':None,'totp_enabled':False}}). NotificationBar uses body class 'has-announcement' to offset header — this is set by the client after fetch, so any header/offset snapshotting must wait ~2-3s after page load.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. Both requested features are working end-to-end: (1) public GET /api/announcements → NotificationBar component renders on homepage with correct text/link/close; (2) admin JWT-protected POST/PUT/DELETE for /api/announcements, /api/events, /api/team, /api/reviews, /api/blogs all succeed and immediately reflect on public GET endpoints (which are what the /events, /team, /blogs, and homepage-review sections consume).
